name: Wakazuma Mangekyou
source:
Shirozaki Takafumi is a security guard at a grocery store who uses his position to frame housewives and then blackmail them for sex. Apparently that works. Kogure Mayumi is his latest victim. On the pretense of her “stealing” a container of pepper Shirozaki begins to associate with her and eventually basically makes her his sex slave.

[From [url=https://the1000thsummer.wordpress.com/2013/03/08/wakazuma-mangekyou/]1000th Summer blog[/url]]
translation:
城崎隆文是一名超市保安。他利用职务之便栽赃家庭主妇，再以此要挟她们与自己发生关系，而这一手段似乎屡试不爽。小暮真由美就是他最新的受害者。城崎诬称她“偷走”一罐胡椒粉，借此开始与她接触，最终几乎将她变成了自己的性奴隶。

[摘自[url=https://the1000thsummer.wordpress.com/2013/03/08/wakazuma-mangekyou/]1000th Summer博客[/url]]
